brief:
The Green Party, in a members' vote on Sunday, recognized Zionism as a form of racism and endorsed the establishment of a single democratic Palestinian state with equal rights for all ethnic and religious groups, Middle East Eye reported.

The party's position contrasts with its previous stance on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The members' vote backed a unified state model rather than a two-state solution, with equal citizenship rights for all residents as the framework's foundation.

title: Green Party votes to recognize Zionism as racism, endorses single Palestinian state
